messages:
Lucas: Short thread: from the cache-thrash postmortem we need compact runbook edits: a small triage script, explicit escalation steps, and a safe-ops snippet. Keep it one-page.

Maya: +1. I can draft a one-page "Quick Triage" with 5 checks and exact commands.

Raj: I'll add the fallback routing and a tiny policy snippet to force model-variant routing. Example: set route header X-Model: redwood/quant-v2.

Jamie: I will own the escalation bullets: who to page at 0/5/15 mins and the Slack webhook command for eng-oncall.

Sophie: Ops note: include a guarded flush command and a checklist before running it (confirm impact window, notify product). Snippet: ```bash
# guarded prefix flush
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flush-prefix
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"prefix":"user-kv","dry_run":true}'
# remove dry_run only after oncall-lead ack
```

Maya: Proposed triage checks (I'll add exact commands in PR): 1) pod health + logs, 2) redis memory + evictions, 3) recent cache_miss_rate, 4) queue/backpressure, 5) quick failover to fallback variant.

Raj: For fallback routing I'll add sample policy: ```json
{"route_policy":"fallback_quant","match":{"prefix":"/gen"},"action":{"model":"redwood/quant-v2","note":"expect ~+18% latency"}}
```

Jamie: Timeline & owners: maya -> triage one-pager (due 2026-04-07), raj -> fallback policy + snippet (due 2026-04-08), jamie -> escalation bullets + webhook script (due 2026-04-06).

Lucas: Assigning. I'll create TASK-4710 to track and schedule a 15m verification sync after PR merges.

karen-bot: Task created: TASK-4710 "Runbook: quick triage + escalation + safe ops" assigned maya, raj, jamie. Due 2026-04-08.

Maya: PR draft soon: GH:infra/playbooks#900 (one-page triage).

Jamie: I'll stub the webhook message example in the runbook.

Lucas: Good. Add a tiny recurrence note: if cache_evictions_per_min > 80 for 5m, mark as "possible regression" and open an incident.

Sophie: I'll add the pre-run checklist and rollback guidance to the runbook before we merge.

Lucas: Thanks all — short and actionable. Follow-up check scheduled after due date. :white_check_mark:
